creative_direction: Create a head-and-shoulders portrait of Satoru Gojo with unmistakable lifted white hair, a relaxed long face, and his eyes uncovered. Dress him in a simple navy high-collar jacket, with one hand raised beside his shoulder in an easy greeting. Turn his torso slightly while keeping the face nearly frontal and both eyes clear. Use clean cel shading, broad sky-blue background planes, and a small ivory cloud shape. His smile is slight rather than exaggerated. Keep the hand compact and the white hair silhouette safely within the frame. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
